jobs.title: Finance & Python Expert — AI Model Quality Reviewer
jobs.description:
About The Role

What if your deep knowledge of financial modeling could directly shape how AI performs the work of a professional analyst? We're looking for Finance Subject Matter Experts who also know their way around Python and GitHub to audit, refine, and improve AI-generated financial modeling tasks — making sure they mirror how real analysts actually work.

You'll review AI task instructions and scoring rubrics, then roll up your sleeves and edit Markdown files and Python scripts directly via Pull Requests to fix logic errors, close clarity gaps, and ensure every task meets professional standards. If you can build a DCF in your sleep and know your way around a P&L, this role was made for you.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. Candidates must have strong US-based financial knowledge and fluency with American financial terminology and conventions.

Organization: Alignerr
Type: Hourly Contract
Location: Remote
Compensation: $80–$110/hour
Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

Audit AI-generated financial modeling tasks to ensure they accurately replicate professional analyst workflows
Validate task instructions and scoring rubrics for logical soundness, completeness, and real-world relevance
Directly edit Markdown files and Python scripts via Pull Requests to resolve logic errors, ambiguity, or clarity gaps
Evaluate whether AI outputs reflect correct application of concepts like DCF analysis, P&L interpretation, financial statement modeling, and valuation techniques
Provide clear, structured feedback grounded in professional financial expertise
Collaborate asynchronously with a distributed team using GitHub-based workflows
Work independently on task-based assignments at your own pace and schedule

Who You Are

Deep subject matter expertise in finance — you've worked as an analyst, in investment banking, corporate finance, equity research, FP&A, or a closely related field
Strong command of US-based financial terminology and frameworks (DCF, P&L, balance sheet analysis, WACC, comparable company analysis, etc.)
Proficient in Python — comfortable reading, writing, and debugging scripts used for financial calculations
Experienced with GitHub — you can clone repos, create branches, and submit Pull Requests without hand-holding
Comfortable editing Markdown for technical documentation
Detail-oriented with a systematic, quality-driven approach to review work
Clear, precise written communicator who can articulate what's wrong and why
Self-motivated and reliable when working independently

Nice to Have

CFA, CPA, or MBA with a finance concentration
Professional experience building financial models in Excel or Python for deal evaluation, forecasting, or valuation
Background in teaching, mentoring, or creating training materials for financial concepts
Familiarity with AI/ML evaluation workflows or data annotation projects
Experience writing or reviewing technical rubrics or assessment criteria

Why Join Us

Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, high-impact task-based work
Apply your hard-earned financial expertise to a genuinely novel problem — teaching AI to think like a real analyst
Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

jobs.description:
About Nexon

Nexon America is a branch of Nexon Co., Ltd., a global video game publisher and leading developer of online virtual worlds for PCs, consoles, and mobile devices. Nexon proudly offers celebrated franchises like MapleStory and Mabinogi that have been enjoyed by millions of players for over two decades. When we founded our Nexon America branch in 2006, we made it our goal to bring those unique games to western players using a player-first approach. We achieve that goal by applying our team’s outstanding free-to-play expertise and live game support to every decision, every day.

But we’re committed to more than our games! Here at Nexon America, we’re all about open communication, diversity, mutual respect, and collaboration, so we can bring out the best in each other. Nexies find support, friendship, and career growth all in one place! And because we know a healthy work-life balance is the key to happiness, Nexies also enjoy flexible hours, a hybrid work model, and extra perks like food trucks, happy hours, and team events. It’s why we’ve earned the Great Place to Work certification for 6 years running!

We’re looking to expand our team with passionate individuals who want to learn, play, and grow with us. Ready for a new challenge?

Summary Of Position

Nexon America is looking for a Data Analyst to provide in-depth data mining and analyses to multiple departments, with a focus on understanding our players and identifying ways to improve the user experience within our games. In this role, you will empower our teams with actionable data derived from your own data exploration, experiments, and analyses.

We are currently working in the office 2-3x a week in a hybrid work model.

Job Responsibilities

Design and develop data analyses to create unique business insights; perform detailed data exploration and validation to understand players’ behavior and trends.
Identify key analytic metrics; build interactive data visualizations and present key insights to inform business decisions and drive growth; examine and analyze available information to determine patterns and gaps at a strategic level and recommend a course of action to support internal and external users.
Research and analyze web and game usage data and recommend solutions; analyze the user experience and business processes to identify opportunities for improvement.
Work cross-functionally with internal stakeholders to translate business data needs into analysis specifications and validate requirements against strategic goals and project objectives.
Develop innovative projects and hone cutting-edge skills in Data Cloud technologies, Data Science models, Data storytelling, and AI.
Other duties as assigned

Work Experience

3+ years of experience in data analytics, sales analysis, consulting, statistics, or a related field
Experience with data extraction and manipulation tools and Data Mining tools
Experience creating data visualization
Online gaming experience preferred

Education, Professional Training, Technical Training or Certification

Master's Degree preferred or Bachelor's degree with equivalent experience

Knowledge/Skills

Excellent knowledge of statistical analysis
Ability to extract data by writing your own SQL queries
Experience using Tableau or similar BI tools
Experience using Google Analytics preferred
Programming for data analysis (R or Python) preferred
Ability to translate complex data into stories for diverse stakeholders
Strong interpersonal and communication skills
Able to manage shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment
Exceptional Excel and PowerPoint skills
Excellent time and project management skills

Management has the right to add or change duties and job requirements at any time.

Nexon’s Benefits And Perks

We offer medical, dental and vision plans for you, your spouse or domestic partner and your children. Employees who enroll in the high deductible health plan receive an annual employer contribution to a health savings account and company paid hospital indemnity benefits. We also provide company paid life, AD&D, short-term and long-term disability benefits as well as access to voluntary life and AD&D for yourself and your dependents, flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) savings plan with a company match, and pet insurance. Nexies are encouraged to take advantage of our monthly wellness credit, participate in lunchtime yoga, and enroll in language classes. We host bi-monthly catered lunches, monthly happy hours, and maintain a well-stocked snack bar. To help you maintain a good work life balance, we offer paid time off, sick days, company holidays, and a year-end break.

Nexon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

jobs.description:
Innovative research paves the way for improved patient outcomes. You can be a part of the research that’s driving new treatments and procedures at Legacy. In your role, you will provide general and technical assistance, clerical support, laboratory maintenance and assist with collection of scientific data. If you’re ready to grow your skills and share in the Legacy mission of making life better for others, we invite you to consider this opportunity.

The Robert Stone Dow Neuroscience Laboratories at the Legacy Research Institute in Portland, Oregon, is seeking a Research Assistant 1 to play an active role in research focusing on the role of novel non-coding RNAs in memory formation and Alzheimer's disease-associated cognitive impairment. The successful candidate will join a dynamic, team-oriented, and expanding research group in the Impey lab and participate at all levels of the project, including functional genomics, spatial transcriptomics, rodent transgenic models, molecular biology, cell culture, and viral vector preparation. Research assistants are expected to design/interpret experiments, generate publication quality analyses, and to help write manuscript/grant sections. Applicants should have a BA/BS in a biology-related major and 1-2 years of previous research experience is strongly preferred. To learn more about the Impey lab click here.

Responsibilities

This is an entry-level research assistant position. It provides, under close supervision of a Principal Investigator, general and technical assistance in support of a specific research program, including (but not limited to): clerical tasks; laboratory maintenance; ordering and inventorying laboratory supplies; and production and collection of scientific data. Research assistants at this level, unlike higher-level research assistants, would not be expected to perform their own research.

Laboratory Technician is the intermediate level in this classification series. Under general guidance from the chemist or microbiologist, Laboratory Technicians in this class perform a variety of tasks. Laboratory Technicians at this level may be required to train/cross-train other laboratory technicians, as required. Laboratory Technicians assist the laboratory with shipping, receiving, data entry, routine analysis, glassware, sample kits, sample preparation, and clean-up. These tasks are conducted under general guidance from the laboratory personnel responsible for the specific laboratory section. Performs other duties of a similar nature and level. This position is located in Commerce, CA.

Essential Functions

Print sample labels, COCs, and sampling instruction sheets
Review scheduled sample lists, prepare and ship sample kits accordingly
Ship and receive sample coolers; log samples into LIMS
Work regularly with computer based applications such as Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS), People Soft, Microsoft Excel
Perform standard QA/QC measures as required; i.e. sign and date forms, fill out log books, etc.
Prepare standard chemical solutions, reagents, and/or bacteriological media
May assist microbiologists/chemists in basic analysis
Receive laboratory shipments from the mailroom and deliver to the intended recipient
Keep laboratory facilities in a clean and orderly condition
Clean and prepare glassware for sample collection
May preserve metal samples per the approved SOP
May digest metals samples per the approved SOP
Enter reviewed data and results of analyses into the Laboratory Information Management System
Neutralize spent samples
Cross-train other technicians for coverage
Assists chemists or microbiologists in sample prep
Participate in Continuous Improvement (CI) activities
May participate in the Safety Committee
Maintain lab, hazardous materials and hazardous waste inventory
Participate in the weekly safety walk
Receive and store lab shipments
Perform other related duties as required

AA in Chemistry or Biology related field with two years of experience working in a laboratory environment, supporting microbiological or chemical analysis, or
One year of experience as a Laboratory Assistant
